title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You should really nudge Al to show me the “Tiger Way.” I’m not looking for proprietary information, I’m just looking for tangible proof that this has been done, given the information I’ve received to the contrary
All it takes is pulling someone’s phone out and scrolling through the “manual,” and then there’s no reason to question if it’s been done or not
